sentences.s: 她从马上摔了下来。
sentences.t: 她從馬上摔了下來。
sentences.en: She fell of her horse.

sentences.s: 没有必要道歉。
sentences.t: 沒有必要道歉。
sentences.en: There's no need to apologize.

sentences.s: 随着网络技术的发展，这些问题迟早都会得到解决。
sentences.t: 隨着網絡技術的發展，這些問題遲早都會得到解決。
sentences.en: With the development of network technology, these problems will be solved sooner or later.

source.title: 迟早
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 中场休息时间到了，比赛双方队员各自回场外休息。
sentences.t: 中場休息時間到了，比賽雙方隊員各自回場外休息。
sentences.en: The intermission time has arrived, and the players on both sides of the game (each by themselves) went back out of the court to rest.

source.title: 各自
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 猴子突然站了起来，张开手臂抱住了管理员。
sentences.t: 猴子突然站了起來，張開手臂抱住了管理員。
sentences.en: The monkey suddenly stood up and opened his arm and hugged the zookeeper.

source.title: V 开
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我的祖父相信登月是一个骗局。
sentences.t: 我的祖父相信登月是一個騙局。
sentences.en: My grandpa believes that the moon landing was a hoax.

sentences.s: 我不想冒这个险。
sentences.t: 我不想冒這個險。
sentences.en: I don't want to run such a risk.

sentences.s: 我赌她赢这比赛。
sentences.t: 我賭她贏這比賽。
sentences.en: I made a bet that she would win the game.

sentences.s: 若是有人对公司来说是不可或缺的，那么这家公司组织得不好。
sentences.t: 若是有人對公司來說是不可或缺的，那麼這家公司組織得不好。
sentences.en: If someone is indispensable to a company, then that company is not well-organized.

sentences.s: 挺好的工作，怎么说不干就不干了？
sentences.t: 挺好的工作，怎麼說不幹就不幹了？
sentences.en: Very good job, how come you quit just like that (without thinking)?

source.title: 说 V/A 就 V/A
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我们都喝醉了。
sentences.t: 我們都喝醉了。
sentences.en: We were both drunk.

sentences.s: 他听到消息后失去了理智。
sentences.t: 他聽到消息後失去了理智。
sentences.en: He went mad when he heard the story.

sentences.s: 有时他让我难以理解。
sentences.t: 有時他讓我難以理解。
sentences.en: I don't understand him sometimes.

sentences.s: 你讲日语吗？
sentences.t: 你講日語嗎？
sentences.en: Do you speak Japanese?

sentences.s: 污染和我们的日常生活密切相关。
sentences.t: 污染和我們的日常生活密切相關。
sentences.en: Pollution is closely related to our daily lives.

source.title: 密切
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 大部分人只想听到他们自己的真理。
sentences.t: 大部分人只想聽到他們自己的真理。
sentences.en: Most people only want to hear their own truth.

sentences.s: 我在北京出生、长大，至今还没离开过呢。
sentences.t: 我在北京出生、長大，至今還沒離開過呢。
sentences.en: I was born and raised in Beijing and have never left to this day.

source.title: 至今
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 所以之前我认为我的约会，或者更确切的说，下线后的网聚将只有我和她，但是事情并非那么简单。
sentences.t: 所以之前我認爲我的約會，或者更確切的說，下線後的網聚將只有我和她，但是事情並非那麼簡單。
sentences.en: So I thought my date, er rather, offline-meeting was going to be just me and her but things aren't that easy.

sentences.s: 我乘船过了河。
sentences.t: 我乘船過了河。
sentences.en: I crossed the river by boat.

sentences.s: 请清洗它。
sentences.t: 請清洗它。
sentences.en: Please wash it.

sentences.s: 那位女生对自己的美貌感到很骄傲。
sentences.t: 那位女生對自己的美貌感到很驕傲。
sentences.en: That girl is arrogant because of her beauty.

sentences.s: 我没什么可依靠的了。
sentences.t: 我沒什麼可依靠的了。
sentences.en: I have nothing to fall back on.

sentences.s: 汤姆昨天没穿牛仔裤。
sentences.t: 湯姆昨天沒穿牛仔褲。
sentences.en: Tom didn't wear jeans yesterday.

sentences.s: 你有没有给孤儿献上一首歌呢？
sentences.t: 你有沒有給孤兒獻上一首歌呢？
sentences.en: Have you ever dedicated a song to the orphans?

sentences.s: 女孩子对衣服颜色的选择往往与她们的性格有关。
sentences.t: 女孩子對衣服顏色的選擇往往與她們的性格有關。
sentences.en: Girls' choice of clothing color is often related to their personality.

source.title: 往往
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 大城市的生活虽然很精彩，但一辈子生活在农村的父母反而会不适应。
sentences.t: 大城市的生活雖然很精彩，但一輩子生活在農村的父母反而會不適應。
sentences.en: Although the life in a big city is very exciting, [my] parents who have lived in rural areas for a lifetime will actually (opposite to what one expects) find themselves ill-adapted.

source.title: 反而
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 你对足球规则熟悉吗？
sentences.t: 你對足球規則熟悉嗎？
sentences.en: Are you familiar with the rules of soccer?

sentences.s: 想起这些，我忍不住要笑。
sentences.t: 想起這些，我忍不住要笑。
sentences.en: When I thought of that, I couldn’t help smiling.

sentences.s: 我们房子里有枪。
sentences.t: 我們房子裏有槍。
sentences.en: We have guns in the house.

sentences.s: 几乎每个人都被邀请了。
sentences.t: 幾乎每個人都被邀請了。
sentences.en: Almost everybody was invited.

sentences.s: 他把我妹妹的玩具都抢走了。
sentences.t: 他把我妹妹的玩具都搶走了。
sentences.en: He deprived my little sister of all her toys.

sentences.s: 正当我坐下来吃晚饭时，偏偏电话来了。
sentences.t: 正當我坐下來喫晚飯時，偏偏電話來了。
sentences.en: It just have to [be] when I sit down and eat supper that a call came.

source.title: 偏偏 CLAUSE
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 晚了！墙上杂志就要发布了！
sentences.t: 晚了！牆上雜誌就要發佈了！
sentences.en: Too late! The wall magazine is ready to be published!

sentences.s: 汤姆在偷听。
sentences.t: 湯姆在偷聽。
sentences.en: Tom's eavesdropping.

sentences.s: 你有没有去问问小王？估计/可能他应该有办法。
sentences.t: 你有沒有去問問小王？估計/可能他應該有辦法。
sentences.en: Have you asked Xiao Wang? Perhaps he should have a solution.

source.title: 估计/可能 CLAUSE
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 金价每天都在变动。
sentences.t: 金價每天都在變動。
sentences.en: The price of gold varies from day to day.

sentences.s: 他什么时候不再书店工作？
sentences.t: 他什麼時候不再書店工作？
sentences.en: Since when does he not work at the bookstore anymore?

sentences.s: 男人觉定在火车站等到他妻子来。
sentences.t: 男人覺定在火車站等到他妻子來。
sentences.en: The man decided to wait at the station until his wife came.

sentences.s: 问问他会不会说日语。
sentences.t: 問問他會不會說日語。
sentences.en: Ask him if he can speak Japanese.

sentences.s: 加入我们的俱乐部吗？
sentences.t: 加入我們的俱樂部嗎？
sentences.en: Will you join our club?

sentences.s: 父亲听说儿子卖了房子，气得(他)直发抖。
sentences.t: 父親聽說兒子賣了房子，氣得(他)直髮抖。
sentences.en: The father heard that his son had sold the house. He was so angry that he kept on shivering.

source.title: V1 得 (O) 直 V2
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 植物会为了阳光、空气和水而竞争。
sentences.t: 植物會爲了陽光、空氣和水而競爭。
sentences.en: Plants compete for sunlight, air, and water.

source.title: 为了 N 而 V
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我希望我没有得到职位。
sentences.t: 我希望我沒有得到職位。
sentences.en: I wish that I hadn't taken the office.

sentences.s: 你将在日本住多久？
sentences.t: 你將在日本住多久？
sentences.en: How long are you staying in Japan?

sentences.s: 你犯了个错误。
sentences.t: 你犯了個錯誤。
sentences.en: You made a mistake.

sentences.s: 我听到汤姆尖叫。
sentences.t: 我聽到湯姆尖叫。
sentences.en: I heard Tom scream.

sentences.s: 他害怕死亡。
sentences.t: 他害怕死亡。
sentences.en: He is afraid of death.

sentences.s: 汤姆试图去追上玛丽，但是他没成功。
sentences.t: 湯姆試圖去追上瑪麗，但是他沒成功。
sentences.en: Tom tried to catch up with Mary, but he couldn't.

sentences.s: 他从路上捡起一样白色的东西。
sentences.t: 他從路上撿起一樣白色的東西。
sentences.en: He picked up something white on the street.

sentences.s: 汤姆打开了电风扇。
sentences.t: 湯姆打開了電風扇。
sentences.en: Tom turned on the electric fan.

sentences.s: 没有什么和时间一样珍贵。
sentences.t: 沒有什麼和時間一樣珍貴。
sentences.en: Nothing is so precious as time.

sentences.s: 我的大衣穿了一个洞。
sentences.t: 我的大衣穿了一個洞。
sentences.en: There's a hole in my coat.

sentences.s: 肯停止说话开始吃东西。
sentences.t: 肯停止說話開始喫東西。
sentences.en: Ken stopped talking and began to eat.

sentences.s: 他们很幸运比赛进入加时赛，因为他们最终获胜。
sentences.t: 他們很幸運比賽進入加時賽，因爲他們最終獲勝。
sentences.en: They were lucky the game went into extra time because they ended up winning.

sentences.s: 我们所有的学生都在学法语。
sentences.t: 我們所有的學生都在學法語。
sentences.en: All of our students are studying French.

sentences.s: 乌鲁木齐有四万个摄像机。
sentences.t: 烏魯木齊有四萬個攝像機。
sentences.en: There are forty thousand cameras in Urumqi.

sentences.s: 我们警告过他了。
sentences.t: 我們警告過他了。
sentences.en: We did warn him.

sentences.s: 你的袜子破了一个洞呀。
sentences.t: 你的襪子破了一個洞呀。
sentences.en: There is a hole in your sock.

sentences.s: 别随随便便就说放弃，说不定下次就成功了。
sentences.t: 別隨隨便便就說放棄，說不定下次就成功了。
sentences.en: Don't just give up so easily, maybe you will succeed next time.

source.title: 说不定
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 玛丽下楼到厨房。
sentences.t: 瑪麗下樓到廚房。
sentences.en: Mary went down to the kitchen.

sentences.s: 您有火柴吗？
sentences.t: 您有火柴嗎？
sentences.en: Do you have a match?

sentences.s: 这餐厅的服务一点效率也没有。
sentences.t: 這餐廳的服務一點效率也沒有。
sentences.en: The service in this restaurant is none too fast.

sentences.s: 汤姆很喜欢作弄我。
sentences.t: 湯姆很喜歡作弄我。
sentences.en: Tom enjoys playing tricks on me.

sentences.s: 我踢足球的时候弄伤了腿。
sentences.t: 我踢足球的時候弄傷了腿。
sentences.en: I had my leg hurt while playing football.

sentences.s: 我想去上海、南京，杭州……总之想去南方转转。
sentences.t: 我想去上海、南京，杭州……總之想去南方轉轉。
sentences.en: I want to go to Shanghai, Nanjing, Hangzhou... In short, I want to go south.

source.title: 总之
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 请你把盐递给我好吗？
sentences.t: 請你把鹽遞給我好嗎？
sentences.en: Will you pass me the salt?

sentences.s: 警察到达了可怕的犯罪现场。
sentences.t: 警察到達了可怕的犯罪現場。
sentences.en: Police arrived at the grisly crime scene.

sentences.s: 这些点都是病毒集中的地方。
sentences.t: 這些點都是病毒集中的地方。
sentences.en: All those dots are viral focuses.

sentences.s: 孩子是我们生命中的花朵。
sentences.t: 孩子是我們生命中的花朵。
sentences.en: Children are the flowers of our lives.

sentences.s: 敌人对我们发起了攻击。
sentences.t: 敵人對我們發起了攻擊。
sentences.en: The enemy launched an attack on us.

sentences.s: 他出来得过于匆忙，居然忘了带手机。
sentences.t: 他出來得過於匆忙，居然忘了帶手機。
sentences.en: He came out too hurriedly and forgot to bring his mobile phone.

source.title: 过于
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 跨行是指一句话在诗歌中从一行跨到下一行的情况。
sentences.t: 跨行是指一句話在詩歌中從一行跨到下一行的情況。
sentences.en: Enjambment is when a sentence from one line of poetry spills over into the next line.

sentences.s: 一些人只买有机的食物，他们认为这样可以使他们的健康不受污染的损害。
sentences.t: 一些人只買有機的食物，他們認爲這樣可以使他們的健康不受污染的損害。
sentences.en: Some people only buy organic food; they think that in this way their body will not be damaged by pollutants.

sentences.s: 你的结论具有高度争议性。
sentences.t: 你的結論具有高度爭議性。
sentences.en: Your conclusion is highly arguable.

sentences.s: 这里夏季的雷阵雨一般可持续数小时或者更久的时间。
sentences.t: 這裏夏季的雷陣雨一般可持續數小時或者更久的時間。
sentences.en: The thunderstorms in summer here generally last for several hours or longer.

source.title: 数 (shù)
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 他被那个故事深深地感动了。
sentences.t: 他被那個故事深深地感動了。
sentences.en: He was deeply moved by the story.

sentences.s: 经过了几番风雨，他才懂得人生的价值。
sentences.t: 經過了幾番風雨，他才懂得人生的價值。
sentences.en: Only after a few (times of) setbacks (lit. storms), he understood the value of life.

source.title: 番
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我想要加入那个队伍。
sentences.t: 我想要加入那個隊伍。
sentences.en: I want to join the team.

sentences.s: 当死亡来敲你的门时，世界上所有的财富都是无用的。
sentences.t: 當死亡來敲你的門時，世界上所有的財富都是無用的。
sentences.en: All the wealth in the world is useless when death comes knocking on your door.

sentences.s: 四处看看。
sentences.t: 四處看看。
sentences.en: Look around.

sentences.s: 我后悔去过那里。
sentences.t: 我後悔去過那裏。
sentences.en: I regret going there.

sentences.s: 很遗憾你不相信我。
sentences.t: 很遺憾你不相信我。
sentences.en: That you don't believe me is a great pity.

sentences.s: 我总是锁上我的房间。
sentences.t: 我總是鎖上我的房間。
sentences.en: I always lock my room.

sentences.s: 他们把我的好日子毁了。
sentences.t: 他們把我的好日子毀了。
sentences.en: They ruined my life.

sentences.s: 好朋友应该彼此帮助。
sentences.t: 好朋友應該彼此幫助。
sentences.en: Good friends should help each other.

source.title: 彼此 V
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我换了窗帘后，房间看起来不同了。
sentences.t: 我換了窗簾後，房間看起來不同了。
sentences.en: The room looks different after I've changed the curtains.

sentences.s: 我没有朋友可以聊天。
sentences.t: 我沒有朋友可以聊天。
sentences.en: I have no friend to talk with.

sentences.s: 自行车在汽车的右侧行驶是不合法的。
sentences.t: 自行車在汽車的右側行駛是不合法的。
sentences.en: Bicycles traveling to the right of automobiles is illegal.

sentences.s: 真是太可惜了！
sentences.t: 真是太可惜了！
sentences.en: What a pity!

sentences.s: 黑帮悬赏捉拿汤姆。
sentences.t: 黑幫懸賞捉拿湯姆。
sentences.en: The mob put a price on Tom's head.

sentences.s: 您当年的假设已经被证明是对的。
sentences.t: 您當年的假設已經被證明是對的。
sentences.en: Your assumptions for the year have been proven to be correct.

source.title: 假设
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 不，我还是喜欢吃蔬菜。
sentences.t: 不，我還是喜歡喫蔬菜。
sentences.en: No, I still prefer eating vegetables.

sentences.s: 在乘坐扶梯时，请握住扶手，并站在黄线内。
sentences.t: 在乘坐扶梯時，請握住扶手，並站在黃線內。
sentences.en: When using the escalator, please hold the handrail and stand within the yellow line.

sentences.s: 对不起，我听不懂。你能慢点儿再说一遍吗？
sentences.t: 對不起，我聽不懂。你能慢點兒再說一遍嗎？
sentences.en: I'm sorry, I do not understand. Can you repeat it a little slower?

sentences.s: 我真的搞不懂为什么。
sentences.t: 我真的搞不懂爲什麼。
sentences.en: I really can't figure out why.

sentences.s: 他习惯性地将钥匙放在了桌子上。
sentences.t: 他習慣性地將鑰匙放在了桌子上。
sentences.en: As usual, he placed the key on the table.

sentences.s: 相比现代音乐，我更喜欢古典音乐。
sentences.t: 相比現代音樂，我更喜歡古典音樂。
sentences.en: I like classical music more than modern music.

sentences.s: 我们的队伍输了所有的比赛。
sentences.t: 我們的隊伍輸了所有的比賽。
sentences.en: Our team lost all of its games.

sentences.s: 你回来的时候我们再说。
sentences.t: 你回來的時候我們再說。
sentences.en: We can talk when you get back.

sentences.s: 她被他的笑容迷住了。
sentences.t: 她被他的笑容迷住了。
sentences.en: She was bewitched by his smile.

sentences.s: 我们决定明年结婚，至于具体时间还要再商量。
sentences.t: 我們決定明年結婚，至於具體時間還要再商量。
sentences.en: We decided to get married next year. As for the specific time, we’ll have to discuss later.

source.title: 至于
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 他唯一的愿望，就是再见他的儿子最后一面。
sentences.t: 他唯一的願望，就是再見他的兒子最後一面。
sentences.en: His only wish was to see his son one last time.

sentences.s: 我偶尔做。
sentences.t: 我偶爾做。
sentences.en: I seldom do that.

sentences.s: 我摘下帽子进了教堂。
sentences.t: 我摘下帽子進了教堂。
